prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset ID: arrival-fragment-ice-b.
Generate ONE small isolated COMPACT FROST AGGREGATE as a transparent game sprite. One connected knobby object, NOT an environmental scene, ice slab or smoke effect.
Reference image 1 supplies cutout presentation, central placement, scale and realistic painted 2.5D style ONLY. Make a NEW irregular compact shape with rounded connected crystalline lobes, not a recolor of the layered earth clod. Reference image 2 and image 3 supply the game's style only; no cloud, backdrop, ground, UI or scene copied.
Subject: a compact asymmetrical hoarfrost chunk with a granular crust and several fused frost lobes, hard crystalline grains and short rime ridges. Mostly opaque pale neutral grey-white, gently darker grey facets for legibility. Rounded knobby overall silhouette, distinctly different from a long clear ice blade. All crystals are connected into the one object, no loose pieces.
FRAMING: one square 1024x1024 RGBA PNG. Put the entire chunk inside the CENTRAL box x=24%..76%, y=24%..76%. Longest size about 50% of the canvas. Centre its mass at x=.50 y=.50. At least 20% completely EMPTY transparent margin on every side.
TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Everything outside the compact chunk must be alpha=0. Do not paint any white background, white halo, glow, fog, mist, bloom, illumination gradient, vignette, atmospheric haze, ground or cast shadow. Lighting is restricted to the small object's own surface.
A bold single-object silhouette readable at 12–24 px. No long blade, soil, roots, leaves, decorative sparkles, extra object, surrounding particles, pile, landscape, text, grid, frame, panel, atlas, sprite sheet, checkerboard or watermark.
